inputs.text: A beautifully animated hand-painted amphibian explorer walks continuously in place toward the right. A clear relaxed two-step walking cycle: the left leg swings forward and plants its webbed foot, then pushes back while the right leg swings past and plants forward. The two legs alternate naturally, with bent knees during passing and straight legs during contact. At least one foot is always on the ground. The pelvis gently rises and falls, the chest counter-rotates and the free arm swings. His short teal cape sways with a soft delayed wave, and the attached hip lantern swings gently. The character stays centered and the camera stays completely fixed. Preserve the illustrated design, the rigid round ivory helmet with one black round lens, the held bone tuning fork and the red rope. Full body visible with padding. Plain flat warm gray background. Smooth lively traditional 2D animation, not a still image.
